checks.label: smoke_environment
checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.label: initial
checks.cause: Testbench allowed an unmodeled rising edge with stale inputs following reset release.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_TB_changes.change: Drive ground=1, dig=0, bump_left=0, bump_right=0 during reset setup so intervening clocks after release leave the reset walking state unchanged.
justified_TB_changes.reason: Prevents stale stimulus from causing a real DUT transition on a clock edge that was outside the step-task oracle. No expected values or checks were removed.

worker_report.interface_cycle_contract: Original one-bit ports; positive-edge clock; positive-edge asynchronous active-high reset to walking left; Moore outputs with no extra latency.
worker_report.implementation: Six-state FSM retaining direction while falling or digging; fall takes precedence over dig, then direction change.
worker_report.static_review: Complete next-state assignments, nonblocking state register update, explicit enum if/else transitions; initial RTL unchanged.
worker_report.verification_coverage: All 16 input combinations from all six reachable states, multi-cycle falling/digging/landing, simultaneous conditions, reset from each state, pre-edge Moore stability, and a 512-cycle varied trace.
